docstring:
Returns the bounding box of the object in the image that is closest in depth to the camera.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    object_prompt (string): Description of object to locate.

Returns:
    list: A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] of the closest object matching the prompt.

Returns the bounding box of the object in the image that is farthest in depth from the camera.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    object_prompt (string): Description of object to locate.

Returns:
    list: A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] of the farthest object matching the prompt.

Counts the number of objects matching the given prompt in the image.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    object_prompt (string): Description of object to count.

Returns:
    int: The number of objects matching the prompt.

Returns the color of the object specified by a bounding box.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the object.

Returns:
    string: The color of the object in the bounding box.

Returns the real-world height of an object in meters, given a reference object with a known height.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the target object.
    ref_bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the reference object.
    ref_height (float): The known real-world height of the reference object in meters.

Returns:
    float: The real-world height of the target object in meters.

Returns the real-world width of an object in meters, given a reference object with a known width.

Args:
    image (image): Image of the scene.
    bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the target object.
    ref_bbox (list): A bounding box [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] containing the reference object.
    ref_width (float): The known real-world width of the reference object in meters.

Returns:
    float: The real-world width of the target object in meters.
